newsitem.title: USA: VTEL completes Compression Labs merger.
newsitem.headline: VTEL completes Compression Labs merger.

text.p: VTEL Corp said Tuesday it had completed its merger with Compression Labs Inc following approval of the deal by VTEL shareholders.
VTEL said the new company will retain the VTEL name and headquarters in Austin, Texas, and will employ more than 800 people.
The previously announced merger was consummated by an exchange of 8.4 million VTEL shares for all outstanding Compression Labs shares.
VTEL now has about 22.5 million shares outstanding.

Dick Moeller, VTEL's chairman and chief executive, said the merger "positions VTEL as the number two global supplier of videoconferencing systems and presents a substantive opportunity to increase service revenues."
VTEL designs and manufactures Smart Videoconferencing systems.
